theme_and_archetype.archetype: Cinematic Frost (Hybrid of Archetype 5 Luxury & Archetype 7 Electric)
theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end editorial gaming review website blending the cinematic depth of luxury brands with cold, precise, icy-blue gamer aesthetics. The UI avoids pure black, favoring deep navy/charcoal voids paired with frosted glassmorphism and striking neon cyan accents.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tighter text-slate-50
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight text-slate-100

anti_patterns: Do not use Inter for headings.
Never center-align large blocks of text; favor left-alignment for editorial feel.
Avoid huge scale jumps between headings and subheadings (e.g., text-6xl directly to text-sm).

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Always use tinted darks (gray-950, slate-950).
Do not use full-screen bright gradients. Rely on textured dark backgrounds and isolated glows.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet at least 4.5:1.

bento_cards.classes: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8 hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-colors duration-300

glowing_borders.usage: Highlighting S-Tier reviews or primary CTAs
glowing_borders.classes: relative before:absolute before:-inset-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-cyan-500 before:to-blue-600 before:rounded-2xl before:opacity-50 before:blur-sm

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. gap-8 to gap-12 for bento grids.

grids.bento_asymmetric: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

landing_page.hero: Cinematic hero image overlay with max bg-slate-950/60 opacity. Huge Fraunces typography. Minimalist primary CTA.
landing_page.stats_section: Bento Grid (Control Room style) showing Total Reviews, Average Score, Top Platform.
landing_page.recent_reviews: Asymmetric bento grid or horizontal scroll. Images should be large and dominant, treated like magazine covers.

reviews_listing.layout: Sidebar structure. Left column (md:col-span-3) for Filters (Platform, Genre, Score Range). Right column (md:col-span-9) for review cards.
reviews_listing.components: Use Shadcn Checkbox, Slider (for score), and Select for filtering. Render results in a responsive grid.

review_detail.header: Massive immersive hero header. The game's score must be a floating, highly visible glowing badge.
review_detail.content: Editorial layout using `@tailwindcss/typography` (prose prose-invert). Use left alignment.
review_detail.pros_cons: Custom Shadcn cards with green checkmarks (lucide-react) for Pros and red/muted crosses for Cons.

tier_list.layout: Distinct vertical sections for each tier (S, A, B, C, D, F).
tier_list.styling: S-Tier must have glowing icy borders. Use the defined `tier_colors` for badge labels.

guidelines_page.layout: Scrollytelling or clean bento boxes explaining the 0-10 scale. Use generous negative space.

about_contact.layout: Split layout. Left: Writer bio and image. Right: Glassmorphic Shadcn Form for Resend integration.

component_usage.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea, Select. Must use high-contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).
component_usage.buttons: Shadcn Button. Primary: bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 hover:bg-cyan-400. Secondary: border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-50.
component_usage.motion: Framer Motion. Use subtle fade-ups (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) and staggered list animations.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='review-filter-platform'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA standards. Add text-shadow to text over images if necessary.
testing_and_accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations with respect to user motion preferences.

hero_icy_gaming_bg.description: Abstract 3D floating glass and controller. Use as main Landing Page hero background.

review_guidelines_bg.description: Abstract dark icy terrain. Use as the background for the Review Guidelines page.

about_gamer_setup.description: Macro shot of a mechanical keyboard and mouse. Use on the About page next to the bio.

tier_list_header.description: Glowing neon tier ranks. Use as the header/hero image for the Tier List page.

article_placeholder.description: Glowing blue holographic play button. Use as a fallback thumbnail for review articles.

generic_controller_1.description: Dark moody close-up of a game controller. Use as a placeholder for review cards.

generic_controller_2.description: Close-up of glowing gaming controllers. Use as a placeholder for review cards.
